description: This file defines the EntityLinks filter plugin for Drupal, which updates entity links with data attributes to point to the latest entity URL aliases. It includes class definition, methods for processing text and generating URLs, and handles entity translation and cache dependencies.

classes.name: EntityLinks
classes.description: A Drupal filter plugin class that updates entity links with current URL aliases, supporting translation and cache dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the EntityLinks filter class, injecting the entity repository.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes input text to update entity links with latest URLs, handling translation and cache dependencies.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL object for a given entity, using the entity's link target handler if available.
